**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

No Client-payable liquidated damages, penalty, or early-termination/minimum-fee-on-exit mechanic exists in the Agreement:

- **§5 Compensation (p0045, p0047)** — Client pays fees for requested Hosting/Support Services, subject to monthly minimums. These are ongoing charges for periods in which services are supplied, not a stipulated sum triggered by termination or breach.
- **§14 Termination (p0079)** — Client may elect to terminate on written notice; services (and fees) simply run to the last day of the following month. No exit fee, accelerated remaining-term charge, or buyout.
- **§13 Term (p0078)** — natural-term non-renewal on 30 days' notice; no penalty attaches.
- **§7 / §8(f) spam covenants** — reserve only TrueLink's ordinary "legal and equitable rights"; no per-message or fixed charge.
- **§12 Indemnity / §28 Attorney fees** — actual-loss and actual-cost recovery only; no pre-agreed damages figure.

Since the absence of any Customer-payable liquidated amount already achieves the preferred position, no redline was proposed. We would resist any later insertion of an exit fee exceeding three months' fees, and would require that any such fee be the sole liquidated amount payable by us.
